نحتاز (form VIII)
# نَحْتَازُ (naḥtāzu) /naħ.taː.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# نُحْتَازُ (nuḥtāzu) /nuħ.taː.zu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# نَحْتَازَ (naḥtāza) /naħ.taː.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# نُحْتَازَ (nuḥtāza) /nuħ.taː.za/: first-person plural non-past
